reviews.comment: Your entire grade is based on 7 quizzes. It is not entirely clear what you need to be studying. The only way to earn a good grade in this class is to attend the zoom meetings every week and read all of the materials he posts under each module. Quizlets helped me a lot to study for the quizzes. He is a great guy, very funny and kind.

This class is not an easy one. You are graded by 7 quizzes and that is it. Quizzes are not proctored, but you will find answers in materials and not online. I highly recommend going to the biweekly zoom he holds, because he will give a few answers for the quiz and clarify the material. Overall, with only 7 quizzes, there's no room for error.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: No tests, 7 quizzes, no homework, completely online, no proctoring. What more can you ask for?

I consistently find myself impressed with the Agricultural Economics department at Texas A&M. Every one of my professors excels at teaching me the needed materials to succeed in their course. They are overwhelmingly nice and want you to reach your academic potential. This guy is the absolute opposite of that - an embarrassment to the department.

Overall horrible class! The professor provides little to no information regarding the expectations of the class, the quiz material is not even related to the class subject, and the quizzes include random questions which have not been previously discussed. The only reason the professor gets away with this is no one else teaches the same course.

This class was horrible. He only assigns 7 quizzes throughout the semester. His quizzes are all true or false questions but they are not easy. His lectures are not helpful because he goes off on random tangents. He does NOT curve your grade at the end of the semester. Overall this is the worst professor I have ever had at Texas A&M.

Honestly Professor Boadu was an overall great professor, yes his class is definitely difficult and you have to be sure to attend his lectures or else you will not pass. He definitely cares about his students and I feel like I learned a lot from his lectures and readings he assigned. It was an intimidating class, but honestly I would take again.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor is quite simply not very good. The course is extremely disorganized, the only assignments are discussion posts and 7 quizzes (true/false) the entire semester. The quizzes are extremely confusing and during the course of my time here at Texas A&M, I have never experienced a professor who was more disorganized and hard to contact.
